from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyOtherPayables(BaseModel):
    """Other Payables amount reported by one company in their financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock/Securities code")
    other_payables_amount: float | None = Field(description="Amount of '其他应付款' (Other Payables) as reported")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of the amount, e.g., 'CNY', '元'")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The period the financial report covers")
    balance_type: str | None = Field(description="Balance type, e.g., '期末余额' (ending balance), '上年末余额' (prior period balance)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_other_payables: list[CompanyOtherPayables]
